iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 68. STABLE: Islamabad talks collapsed. US demands 20-year enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 years. IAEA DG Grossi urges strict verification in any deal - says enrichment duration is political decision. Iran has enough uranium for ~10 bombs per Grossi. IAEA locked out 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. Trump claims Iran agreed to everything - Iran calls alternative facts. No second round date set. Iran warns UN/IAEA of radiological risk from US-Israeli strikes on nuclear facilities. Probability 34%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 68. RISING: IRGC FULLY CLOSED Strait of Hormuz Apr 18, firing on at least 3 commercial vessels including Indian-flagged tanker. Iran says Hormuz will NOT reopen until US ends blockade. Trump warns Iran not to blackmail US. Ceasefire expires Apr 22 in 3 DAYS. No second round of talks scheduled - Tehran says no date set. Oil ~$97/bbl despite Hormuz closure. Bloomberg warns $110+ oil scenario. India summoned Iran ambassador. US naval blockade continues. Houthi leader blames US. Probability 48%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 68. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire (started Apr 16) mostly holding, expires Apr 26. Trump invites Israel & Lebanon leaders to White House - first high-level talks since 1983. Lebanese President Aoun refused to speak to Netanyahu directly. Israel holds 10km buffer zone inside Lebanon. Hezbollah NOT part of deal - remains armed, launched 38 attacks day before ceasefire. Israeli drone killed 1 in south Lebanon. 2,196 Lebanese killed total. Hormuz closure complicates regional dynamics. Probability 17%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened Europe largest warhead plant (Lalahan), fuel plant, missile integration facilities Apr 7. Largest defense investment in Republic history. TAYFUN Block-4 hypersonic entering mass production. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned 2026. Defense spending $27.34B. Probability 6%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 - Tier II risk. India summoned Iran ambassador after Indian vessel attacked in Hormuz. First India-Pakistan drone war in May 2025 (Operation Sindoor). India rejected US mediation claims. PM Sharif in Qatar mediating. Probability 7%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 70. RISING: Finland proceeding with nuclear weapons hosting - parliament vote expected. First of 64 F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Russian Ambassador to Finland confirms delivery timeline. Finnish professor warns Finland could be first target in NATO-Russia war. Denmark intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Russia reinforcing nuclear/Arctic assets near Finnish border. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 26%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: China says military activities around Taiwan reasonable and justified - defiant posture. Reuters confirms China changing tactics amid Middle East chaos. Blocking Philippines from disputed shoal. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun for 2028 elections outreach. CBS: China weighing supplying Iran advanced radar - major escalation if true. ISW/AEI update: escalating on multiple fronts. Taiwan extended conscription, $14B US arms. CNN reports Taiwanese buying escape property in Thailand. Probability 37%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 66. STABLE: Kim oversaw 3-day weapons test series last week including cluster-bomb warheads, 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer, ICBM engine test. 6th missile test of 2026. Cruise missile tests from new warship. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. No new nuclear test since Apr 14. Probability 10%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1171+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded across Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa, Dnipro. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - Baltic ports Primorsk (40% storage lost), Ust-Luga (30%), Crimea Feodosia destroyed. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones. Russia warns Europe against funding Ukraine drone production. Russian advances near Kostiantynivka. ISW: Russia maintains expansive territorial goals. Probability 89%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues. Pakistan declared open war on Taliban - bombed Kabul. China actively mediating. Eid ceasefire collapsed. Border clashes ongoing. CSIS: crisis drifting from resolution. Probability 8%. Stable.
